tool_input_args.value:
target_deals = {"D001", "D003", "D006"}
lines = sales_csv.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0].split(',')

matched_records = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = line.split(',')
    row = dict(zip(header, fields))
    if row['deal_id'] in target_deals:
        matched_records.append(row)

# Display results
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep Name':<18} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12} {'Status':<8}")
print("-" * 95)
for r in matched_records:
    print(f"{r['deal_id']:<10} {r['rep_name']:<18} {r['region']:<8} {r['product']:<25} ${int(r['amount']):>9,} {r['close_date']:<12} {r['status']:<8}")

total = sum(int(r['amount']) for r in matched_records)
print("-" * 95)
print(f"{'Total':.<61} ${total:>9,}")
print(f"\n{len(matched_records)} records extracted.")

**Period:** July 1 – September 7, 2026

## Executive Summary

Q3 2026 marks another strong quarter for Meridian Analytics. Across our 15-person team we
